record.oneLiner: Atlassian issue-tracking REST API with OAuth 2.0 (3LO) and API-token Basic auth, plus Atlassian's cloud-hosted Rovo MCP server.
record.verdictReason: A free Cloud Developer Bundle site lets developers create OAuth 2.0 (3LO) apps and API tokens self-serve. The official Rovo MCP server is documented. apiType and apiBreadth evidence was not captured verbatim, so those values are unverified.

evidence.quote: allows external applications and services to access Atlassian product APIs on a user's behalf.
The Cloud Developer Bundle provides a free Atlassian cloud development site for building and testing apps.
The Atlassian Rovo MCP Server is a cloud-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
